about_the_game:
[Bugs exist in the demo and necessary instructions]

1. Buttons cannot be selected once mouse is used, please do not use mouse while playing the demo.

2. Press X while holding UP or DOWN to use the wand vertically.

3. Press ESC to open the menu.

4. Press S to skip the dialogue.

[What's included the demo]

This is the demo of the game 'Trapped'. It only contains the first 8 levels of the game where the whole game has 16 levels in total.

The demo cannot be played with controllers right now even though it displays information about the how to control the character using controller. The full game will be playable using controller.

[Key Features]

Explore caves, solving puzzles and find the exit.

Having conversations with your smiley face cube fellow in each cave/level.

2 different caves, 2 different topics(school, family). (The full game has 4 topics)

[tips]

Keep an eye on the shiny areas in each cave/level.

In order to make the exit/portal appear, the completion degree has to reach 80%, which mean you have to dig at least 80% of the soils in each cave.

You may have to grab the keys to unlock the locks in the cave first.

You may face spiders and other dangerous items, be careful!!
